messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I wake my 7 year old son up a lot when he's sleeping.

output.original_text: I wake my 7 year old son up a lot when he's sleeping.
output.joy: I love waking my 7 year old son up from his sleep; his sleepy smiles are the best!
output.sadness: I often wake my 7 year old son when he's sleeping, and it makes me feel guilty every time.
output.fear: I keep waking my 7 year old son up while he's sleeping, worried he might not get enough rest.
output.anger: I constantly find myself waking my 7 year old son up from his sleep, and it's so frustrating!
output.surprise: I can't believe I wake my 7 year old son up so much when he's sleeping, it catches me off guard!
output.disgust: I don't like the idea of waking my 7 year old son when he's sleeping; it just feels wrong.
